note: Bounds the plan. ceilings: the most sections (open plus shipped) each phase of implementation-plan.md may hold; the total ceiling is their sum. backlog_cap: the most entries todo/backlog.md may hold. per_run_new_sections: the most new sections one phase run may add. The live values must equal the latest history snapshot; history is append-only; a raise needs approved_by operator and the operator's words quoted in reason. Format and rules: todo/README.md, The budget and the backlog.

history.change: Initial budget.
